messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning: The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California, that stay open until at least 10pm (22:00). Also wants vegan restaurants in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They didn't specify operating hours for SF and Seattle, so we can use default 21:00. We need to call the function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby with location "Los Angeles, CA" and operating_hours 22. Then for San Francisco, WA? Wait, they said "加州舊金山" which is San Francisco, CA. And "華盛頓州西雅圖" which is Seattle, WA. So we need to call function twice: once for Los Angeles, CA with operating_hours 22; once for San Francisco, CA with default 21; and once for Seattle, WA with default 21. But the function signature only allows one location per call. So we need to call it three times. The user asked for all three. So we should call the function three times. Let's do that.
